name: engagement
title: Engagement
description: The events analytics tools capture automatically — scroll depth, outbound and contact clicks, file downloads, video plays and form submissions — with no instrumentation. Works on any site.

platforms.name: Any website
platforms.notes: No platform integration required. Reads only the DOM, so it works alongside a commerce or consent plugin.

install.platform: Google Tag Manager Custom HTML tag

journey.label: Clicks a link carrying an access token
journey.fixture: clicks a link carrying an access token

howItWorks.summary: Reads the page itself. A few delegated listeners on the document see what a visitor does, so nothing on the site needs instrumenting and it works on any site.

steps.title: Scroll depth
steps.detail: A passive `scroll` listener measures depth at most once per animation frame and fires `engagement.scroll` at 25, 50, 75 and 90% (`scrollThresholds`), each once per view. `popstate` on `window` resets the thresholds on back and forward navigation.

steps.title: Links, contact links and downloads
steps.detail: One capture-phase `click` listener on `document` reads the clicked link: outbound links, `mailto:` and `tel:` links (their kind only, never the address), and downloads by file extension. Internal links are skipped, because RUM already records them as views. A URL's query string and fragment are never sent.

steps.title: HTML5 video
steps.detail: `play`, `timeupdate` and `ended` do not bubble, so they are captured on `document` for every `<video>`: start, progress at 10, 25, 50 and 75%, and completion.

steps.title: Forms, without reading a field
steps.detail: `focusin` marks a form as started, once. `submit` reports the form's id, label and destination host. No field value is read, at any point. A form marked `data-dd-lead` (or `data-lead`) also sends `lead.generate_lead`.

steps.title: Consent
steps.detail: It has no consent source of its own. Pair it with a consent plugin, or pass `consent: 'ignore'` when the page already holds RUM's tracking consent.

options.name: scrollThresholds
options.description: Depth percentages that fire engagement.scroll. Each fires once per view.

options.name: downloadExtensions
options.description: Extensions treated as a download. Defaults to common documents, archives and media.

options.name: leadFormSelector
options.description: Forms matching this also emit lead.generate_lead on submit.

options.name: trackVideo
options.description: HTML5 video start, progress and completion.

options.name: actionPrefix
options.description: Renames the commerce prefix only; engagement and lead keep their own.

options.name: consent
options.description: auto holds events until consent is granted, ignore defers to the host page.

options.name: beforeTrack
options.description: Edit or drop an event before it is sent.

options.name: debug
options.description: Log every mapped event to the console.
